Purpose (1 line): Display modal dialog for year selection; calls runConsolidateForYear for selected year

Purpose (1 line): Process files from a specific year only (bypasses auto year-detection)
Output / Returns: Same as consolidateGRTemplateData; Logs results per year
Side Effects: Same as consolidateGRTemplateData but filtered to single year
Errors & Fixes: Same as consolidateGRTemplateData
Notes: Called with user-selected year; ensures balanced per-year processing

Purpose (1 line): Create time-based trigger to run consolidateGRTemplateData every 1 minute
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Automation" → "Start Auto Trigger (1 min)"
Output / Returns: None (trigger created); Stores BOUND_SPREADSHEET_ID in Script Properties
Side Effects: Creates Apps Script time-based trigger; automatic processing begins ~1 min after call
Errors & Fixes: Trigger creation fails → Check if trigger already exists (open Triggers in Apps Script); Try stopping first then starting; Verify permissions
Notes: Automatic processing runs 24/7; respects daily quota limits; runs ~1 file per minute

Purpose (1 line): Remove the automatic 1-minute time-based trigger
Output / Returns: None (trigger deleted); Automatic processing stops
Side Effects: Deletes time-based trigger; processing only on manual clicks
Errors & Fixes: Trigger deletion fails → Open Apps Script Triggers page; manually delete
Notes: Graceful stop; can re-enable anytime via setupAutomaticEvery1Min

Purpose (1 line): Display detailed status of last automatic run including times; files; rows added; next run ETA
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Automation" → "Show Auto Processing Status"
Output / Returns: None (modal displayed); Shows status including last run times; file count; row count; next run ETA
Side Effects: Displays detailed modal with run state from Script Properties
Errors & Fixes: Status shows ""Idle"" always → Check if trigger exists (open Apps Script Triggers); Status very old → No automatic runs have executed yet
Notes: Great for monitoring auto processing health

Purpose (1 line): Orchestrate all steps for one file: convert Excel → open → parse → append → cleanup
Invoked By / Menu: consolidateGRTemplateData() loop for each file in candidate list
Input Parameters: ss (Spreadsheet): bound spreadsheet; fileInfo (Object): {id; name; year; month; url}; tempFolder (Folder): Google Drive temp folder
Output / Returns: Object: {rowsAdded (number); status (string); timings (Object): {convertMs; openMs; parseMs; appendMs; totalMs}}
Side Effects: Creates & deletes temp file; appends rows to output sheet; updates performance log
Errors & Fixes: File not converting → Check file size (<10MB); Try different Excel format; Verify Drive API enabled; Permission error → Verify access to source folder
Notes: Core logic for single-file processing; includes try-catch with cleanup in finally block

Purpose (1 line): Use Google Drive API to convert Excel file to temporary Google Sheet
Output / Returns: Object: {sheetId (string); sheetUrl (string)}; throws NON_RETRIABLE_TOO_LARGE if >10MB
Side Effects: Creates file in temp folder with "_TEMP_" prefix; calls Drive API; may throw error if conversion fails
Errors & Fixes: File >10MB → Throws NON_RETRIABLE_TOO_LARGE; split file and retry; Drive API temporarily unavailable → Retry after delay; Malformed Excel → File might be corrupted; try opening in Excel locally first
Notes: Critical step; conversion time ~30-60 sec per file; uses Drive.Files.copy API; requires Advanced Drive service enabled

Purpose (1 line): Open converted Google Sheet with retry logic (3 attempts with exponential backoff)
Input Parameters: fileId (string): converted sheet ID; attempts (number): max retry count; delayMs (number): base delay
Output / Returns: SpreadsheetApp object for the sheet; throws error if all retries fail
Side Effects: Calls SpreadsheetApp.openById with retries; waits CONFIG.openRetryDelayMs between attempts
Errors & Fixes: All retries exhausted → Sheet API temporarily unavailable; wait and retry manually; Permission denied → Verify access to converted file
Notes: Retry pattern: 1st try immediately; 2nd after ~500ms; 3rd after ~1000ms

Purpose (1 line): Find best sheet/tab in converted spreadsheet and extract candidate rows
Input Parameters: tempSS (Spreadsheet): converted Google Sheet; fileName (string): original Excel filename (for scoring)
Output / Returns: Object: {rows (Array): row data; columnMap (Object): column name→index mapping; sheetName (string): chosen sheet name}
Side Effects: Determines which sheet in multi-sheet workbook is most likely data source; returns extracted raw rows
Errors & Fixes: No suitable sheet found → Status: ""No data extracted"" or ""Needs manual check""; manual check: is there a ""GR TEMPLATE"" tab? Does any tab have >3 expected columns?
Notes: Uses fast-path preference for "GR TEMPLATE" sheets; fallback scores all sheets by header match count

Purpose (1 line): Score a single sheet and extract rows; detect header and validate column count
Input Parameters: sh (Sheet): candidate sheet; fileName (string): filename; isDirectName (boolean): true if sheet name matches expected
Output / Returns: Object: {score (number); rows (Array); columnMap (Object); reason (string)}; or empty if invalid
Side Effects: Returns scored sheet candidate for comparison
Errors & Fixes: Low score (<3 matches) → Sheet likely not data; High score (>10 matches) → Sheet is probable match
Notes: Scoring logic: count of matched headers + file name token matches; picks highest-scoring sheet

Purpose (1 line): Scan rows to find header row and map column positions to canonical names
Input Parameters: values (Array): 2D array of cell values from sheet
Output / Returns: Object: {headerRowIndex (number): row number (0-based) of header; columnMap (Object): {header name → column index}}; throws if no valid header found
Side Effects: Stores column positions for later extraction
Errors & Fixes: No header found → Status: ""No data extracted""; Fix: Check file format; Ensure header row exists; Verify >3 key columns match expected list
Notes: Scans up to CONFIG.headerScanMaxRows (~80) rows; requires min CONFIG.minHeaderMatches (~3) matches

Purpose (1 line): Given a header row; map each cell to canonical column names (using aliases)
Input Parameters: headerRow (Array): cells from detected header row
Output / Returns: Object: {header name → column index}; example: {"PO No.": 2; "Material Description": 4}
Side Effects: Builds mapping used for all downstream row extraction
Errors & Fixes: Aliases too restrictive → Add new alias to HEADER_ALIASES object in script; re-run
Notes: Uses HEADER_ALIASES for fuzzy column matching (e.g., "PO Number" → "PO No.")

Purpose (1 line): Extract data rows from sheet applying all filters (skip summaries; hidden rows; merged cells; empty rows)
Input Parameters: startRow; endRow (number): row range; headerColumnMap (Object): column mapping; rawValues (Array): cell data; sheet (Sheet object): for hidden row check
Output / Returns: Array of row arrays (each row = extracted cells for that row)
Side Effects: Applies sequential filters to identify valid data rows; caches visible row checks; returns only valid rows
Errors & Fixes: No rows extracted → Check if all rows below header are summaries or empty; Verify visible/hidden state; Use debug tool
Notes: Filters: hidden rows (if CONFIG.onlyIncludeVisibleRows) → summary rows → footer rows → merged artifacts → empty rows

Purpose (1 line): Look up enrichment data (Region; Site; Territory; USD) for a data row using PLA Lookup sheet
Input Parameters: row (Array): extracted row data; lookupMap (Object): PLA ID→lookup data mapping
Output / Returns: Array: [regionalArea; siteName; territory; usdAmount]
Side Effects: Performs PLA lookup; converts currency to USD if needed; returns enrichment values for appending
Errors & Fixes: Enrichment columns blank → PLA Lookup sheet missing or empty; Fix: create sheet with PLA data; Verify PLA ID in source row matches lookup keys
Notes: Handles special cases: OPEX/Managed Services (different territory treatment); currency conversion

Purpose (1 line): Convert PHP or EUR amounts to USD using CONFIG.usdConversionRate
Input Parameters: amountValue (number/string): amount to convert; currencyValue (string): currency code ("PHP"; "EUR"; "USD"; etc.)
Output / Returns: Number (converted USD amount); or original amount if currency is USD or unknown
Side Effects: Divides amount by CONFIG.usdConversionRate if currency is PHP/EUR; passes through unchanged if USD
Errors & Fixes: Incorrect USD amounts → Update CONFIG.usdConversionRate if exchange rate changed; Re-run ""Recompute USD for All Rows""
Notes: Default rate: 57 PHP/USD; Update when rate changes significantly (e.g., 57 → 58)

Purpose (1 line): Read PLA Lookup sheet and build in-memory map for fast enrichment lookups
Invoked By / Menu: getPlaLookupMapCached_() on first call for each spreadsheet; cached thereafter
Output / Returns: Object: {plaId → {regionalArea; siteName; territory}}; example: {"PH001": {regionalArea: "APAC"; siteName: "Manila"; territory: "PH"}}
Side Effects: Reads entire PLA Lookup sheet into memory; caches per spreadsheet ID
Errors & Fixes: PLA Lookup sheet not found → Script creates it automatically (no data); Add lookup rows manually; Empty lookup → Enrichment columns blank; Add PLA records to populate
Notes: Cached in _CACHE.plaLookupMapBySsId[ssId] to avoid repeated sheet reads; cleared via clearPlaLookupMapCache_()

Purpose (1 line): Append extracted rows to target output sheet with Source File hyperlinks and enrichment columns
Input Parameters: sheet (Sheet): target output sheet (e.g., "GR Posted 2025"); rows (Array): extracted row data; fileInfo (Object): {id; name; url}; controllerSs (Spreadsheet): for enrichment lookup
Output / Returns: Number: count of rows appended
Side Effects: Appends rows to sheet; adds HYPERLINK formulas to Source File column; fills enrichment columns; applies formatting (dates; currency; %)
Errors & Fixes: Append fails → Output sheet not writable; Verify permissions; Check sheet has correct headers; Row count exploding → Archive old data; Performance degrades with >20K rows
Notes: Critical step; adds Source File HYPERLINK formula; formats cells by column type; applies payment milestone % conversion

Purpose (1 line): Verify all required sheets exist (PLA Lookup; Processed Files Log; output sheets); create if missing
Output / Returns: None (creates sheets as needed)
Side Effects: Creates "Processed Files Log"; "PLA Lookup"; "GR Automation Config"; output sheets for each year in CONFIG.outputSheets; adds headers if missing
Errors & Fixes: Sheet creation fails → Permissions issue; Verify you can create sheets in this spreadsheet
Notes: Idempotent: safe to call repeatedly; called on each run to ensure sheets exist

Purpose (1 line): Find or create output sheet for a given year (may resolve to external spreadsheet if configured)
Invoked By / Menu: processSingleFile_() to route rows to correct sheet
Output / Returns: Sheet object for target sheet; may be in bound spreadsheet or external spreadsheet
Side Effects: Creates sheet if missing; may open external spreadsheet if configured in ""GR Automation Config""; ensures enrichment columns exist
Errors & Fixes: Sheet in external spreadsheet not accessible → Verify permissions on target spreadsheet; Verify spreadsheet ID in ""GR Automation Config"" is correct
Notes: Supports multi-spreadsheet setup via "GR Automation Config" sheet

Purpose (1 line): Add result row to Processed Files Log; skip if file was already logged (duplicate prevention)
Input Parameters: ss (Spreadsheet): bound spreadsheet; fileInfo (Object): {id; name; month; year; url}; result (Object): {rowsAdded; status}; processedMap (Object): in-memory map
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if logged; false if skipped as duplicate
Side Effects: Appends row with Timestamp; File Name; Month; Year; Rows Added; Status; File Link; idempotency check prevents duplicates
Errors & Fixes: Duplicate tracker rows → Idempotency check failed (rare); manually delete duplicate row; report issue
Notes: Duplicate detection: 6 different matching keys (filename; ID; URL variants); if ANY key exists in map; skip logging

Purpose (1 line): Log performance metrics (timing data) to ""GR Automation Perf"" sheet
Input Parameters: fileInfo (Object): {id; name; year}; timings (Object): {convertMs; openMs; parseMs; appendMs; totalMs}
Output / Returns: None (appends to Perf sheet)
Side Effects: Appends row to "GR Automation Perf" sheet with Timestamp; File Name; Year; timing breakdown; rows added; status
Errors & Fixes: Perf sheet not created → Auto-created on first call
Notes: Useful for performance monitoring; identify slow files; debug bottlenecks; analyze trends over time

Purpose (1 line): Delete temp files from _GR_AUTOMATION_TEMP folder (move to Drive Trash)
Output / Returns: None (files moved to Trash); notification shows count (e.g.; "5 temp files cleaned up")
Side Effects: Moves all files in temp folder to Drive Trash; frees up Drive space; files recoverable for 30 days from Trash
Errors & Fixes: Cleanup fails silently → Files still in temp folder; manually delete from Drive; permissions issue → Verify you can delete files in temp folder
Notes: Safe to run anytime; routine maintenance (recommend monthly); files are in Trash; not permanently deleted

Purpose (1 line): Show preview (count) of rows that could be matched to source files WITHOUT making changes
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Tracker & Logs" → "Backfill Source Links (Preview)"
Output / Returns: None (notification shows count; e.g.; "20 rows could be matched")
Side Effects: Read-only; no changes made; helps user verify matching logic before applying changes
Errors & Fixes: No matches found → Source files not in source folder; Verify files are uploaded
Notes: Safe to run anytime; good to run before applying; verifies matching confidence

Purpose (1 line): Match output rows to source files and fill Source File column with hyperlinks
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Tracker & Logs" → "Backfill Source Links (Now)"
Output / Returns: None (output sheets updated); Source File column now has HYPERLINK formulas
Side Effects: Updates Source File column in all output sheets with matched file links; some rows may remain blank if no match found
Errors & Fixes: False positives (wrong file linked) → Spot-check rows; matching logic is ~95% accurate for high-PO-number matches; some manual correction may be needed
Notes: Matching: compares PO numbers + filename tokens; confidence threshold prevents most false positives

Purpose (1 line): Backfill missing enrichment columns (Region; Site; Territory) for existing output rows
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "GR Posted Sheets" → "Backfill Lookup & Territory (existing rows)"
Output / Returns: None (output sheets updated); enrichment columns filled for rows that had blanks
Side Effects: Scans all output sheets; looks up enrichment for rows with blank enrichment columns; updates in-place
Errors & Fixes: Some enrichment still blank → PLA Lookup sheet incomplete; Add more PLA records; PLA IDs in data don't match lookup keys; verify exact PLA ID values
Notes: Idempotent: safe to run multiple times; only updates cells that are blank

Purpose (1 line): Recalculate USD conversion for all rows (if CONFIG.usdConversionRate changed)
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "GR Posted Sheets" → "Recompute USD for All Rows"
Output / Returns: None (output sheets updated); USD column values recalculated
Side Effects: Scans all output sheets; recalculates USD amount for each row using new CONFIG.usdConversionRate; updates in-place
Errors & Fixes: All USD amounts still wrong → Verify CONFIG.usdConversionRate is correct; re-run; Check that Amount To Billed column has numeric values
Notes: Useful if exchange rate changed; re-run after updating CONFIG.usdConversionRate

Purpose (1 line): Convert plain-text source file links to clickable HYPERLINK formulas
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "GR Posted Sheets" → "Fix Source File Hyperlinks"
Output / Returns: None (output sheets updated); Source File column now has HYPERLINK formulas
Side Effects: Updates Source File column; converts plain text to hyperlinks; makes links clickable
Errors & Fixes: Some links not converted → May be malformed URLs; manually check format; Test clicking a link after running
Notes: Useful after manual data entry; converts links on existing rows

Purpose (1 line): Ensure all tracker file links are clickable hyperlinks
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Tracker & Logs" → "Fix Tracker File Links"
Output / Returns: None (Processed Files Log updated); File Link column has HYPERLINK formulas
Side Effects: Updates Processed Files Log File Link column; converts plain text to hyperlinks
Errors & Fixes: Some links not converted → Malformed URLs; manually review format; Test clicking a link
Notes: Similar to fixSourceFileHyperlinksNow but for tracker sheet

Purpose (1 line): Fill missing Month column values in Processed Files Log by extracting from filename/file date
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Tracker & Logs" → "Backfill Missing Months"
Output / Returns: None (Processed Files Log updated); Month column has extracted month values
Side Effects: Scans tracker rows; for blanks in Month column; extracts month from filename or file date; updates in-place
Errors & Fixes: Some months still blank → Filename has no month token; file date not available; can manually enter; Month values wrong → Regex extraction matched wrong numbers; manually correct
Notes: Useful for cleaner tracker reporting; improves dashboard accuracy

Purpose (1 line): Check and verify all required sheets and columns exist with correct names; suggests fixes if issues found
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Admin" → "Check Lookup & Output Setup"
Output / Returns: None (modal shown); displays verification result ("Setup verified!" or specific issues)
Side Effects: Scans bound spreadsheet for required sheets; checks headers; reports missing or misconfigured sheets; suggests fixes
Errors & Fixes: Issues reported → Create missing sheet; add missing columns; re-run diagnostic
Notes: Good troubleshooting step; run if script seems broken; suggests exact fixes needed

Purpose (1 line): Process a single file with detailed debug output; useful for troubleshooting why a file fails
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "Admin" → "Test One Source File (Debug)"
Output / Returns: None (file picker shown); after selection; file is processed and debug output displayed
Side Effects: Single file processed; detailed logs shown (headers detected; rows extracted; enrichment; errors); helpful for diagnosing issues
Errors & Fixes: No output shown → Check browser console (F12) for errors; Try different file; File picker doesn't work → Verify permissions
Notes: Excellent for troubleshooting specific files; shows exact header matches; row counts; errors with full context

Purpose (1 line): Scan source Drive folder and build candidate list of new files grouped by year; apply processing limits
Input Parameters: folder (Folder): Drive source folder; failedAttemptsMap (Object): file ID → failure count
Output / Returns: Object: {year → [fileInfo array]}; example: {2025: [{id; name; year; ...}; {...}]; 2026: [...]}
Side Effects: Scans folder; filters by file type; detects year; applies maxFilesPerRunTotal and maxFilesPerRunPerYear limits; skips >10MB and failed files
Errors & Fixes: No files found → Verify source folder exists and has correct name (CONFIG.sourceFolderName); Verify Excel files are actually there
Notes: Candidate list determines what gets processed in current run; respects limits to prevent timeouts

Purpose (1 line): Read Processed Files Log into in-memory map for fast duplicate detection
Output / Returns: Object: {file key → true}; multiple keys per file (filename; ID; URL variants)
Side Effects: Reads tracker sheet; builds map with 6 different key types per file; used to prevent duplicate logging and detect already-processed files
Errors & Fixes: Tracker sheet not found → auto-created; Map incorrect → Manually review Processed Files Log for duplicate rows; clean up if needed
Notes: Critical for idempotency; 6 key types ensure duplicates caught across filename changes; URL variations; Drive ID changes

Purpose (1 line): Read Processed Files Log and count failed attempts per file; skip files with too many failures
Output / Returns: Object: {file ID → failure count}; skips files with >= CONFIG.maxFailedAttemptsPerFile (default 5)
Side Effects: Reads tracker; counts rows with ""no data extracted""; ""error:""; ""needs manual check"" status; counts per file ID; used to skip repeat failures
Errors & Fixes: Map incorrect → Manually fix tracker rows if status is wrong; Reset failure count by deleting old tracker rows for a file
Notes: Prevents wasting time on persistently failing files; can reset by clearing tracker entries

Purpose (1 line): Scan rows to detect header row and map canonical column names to cell indices
Input Parameters: values (Array): 2D array of raw cell values from sheet
Output / Returns: Object: {headerRowIndex (number): 0-based row number; columnMap (Object): {header name → column index}}; throws if no header found
Side Effects: Scans up to CONFIG.headerScanMaxRows (~80); finds row with most header matches; returns column mapping
Errors & Fixes: No header found → Status: ""No data extracted""; Fix by checking file format; ensuring header row with >3 expected columns exists
Notes: Uses fuzzy matching with HEADER_ALIASES; requires min CONFIG.minHeaderMatches (3) matches to be valid

Purpose (1 line): Apps Script onOpen trigger; builds GR Automation menu when spreadsheet opens
Invoked By / Menu: Automatic: runs when sheet opens; Manual: can be triggered by clicking Run in Apps Script
Output / Returns: None (menu created); menu appears in spreadsheet
Side Effects: Creates ""GR Automation"" menu with submenus; called on every sheet open; idempotent
Errors & Fixes: Menu not appearing → Run onOpen manually; Grant permissions when prompted; Reload sheet; Menu items not working → Check CONFIG syntax; Verify functions exist in script
Notes: Automatically runs; safe to trigger manually via Run button in Apps Script

Purpose (1 line): Open and display the PLA Lookup sheet in the spreadsheet
Invoked By / Menu: Manual menu click: "GR Automation" → (top-level action; not in submenu)
Output / Returns: None (sheet activated)
Side Effects: Navigates to "PLA Lookup" sheet; makes it visible
Errors & Fixes: PLA Lookup sheet not found → Script creates it automatically on first run; if missing; run "Check Lookup & Output Setup" diagnostic
Notes: Convenience action; quickly jump to lookup sheet for editing

Purpose (1 line): Read CONFIG.outputSheets and return list of configured years
Output / Returns: Array: [2025; 2026; ...] based on CONFIG.outputSheets keys
Side Effects: Returns years from CONFIG for UI display
Errors & Fixes: Empty array → CONFIG.outputSheets is empty; Edit CONFIG to add years; Years wrong → Verify CONFIG.outputSheets object
Notes: Simple lookup; used for building year picker menu

Purpose (1 line): Read GR Automation Config sheet and return year→sheet→spreadsheet mappings
Invoked By / Menu: getConfigMappingsCached_() on first call; cached thereafter
Output / Returns: Object: {year → {sheetName; spreadsheetId}}; or empty object if no config
Side Effects: Reads ""GR Automation Config"" sheet; builds mapping for external spreadsheet routing
Errors & Fixes: Config sheet not found → auto-created; empty; No mappings → Rows not in config; Add year/sheet/ssId rows to configure
Notes: Optional: if not used; defaults in CONFIG.outputSheets are used

Purpose (1 line): Add a new year mapping to GR Automation Config sheet and optionally create output sheet
Invoked By / Menu: Called programmatically during setup (or manually via menu if exposed)
Input Parameters: year (number): e.g.; 2027; sheetName (string): e.g.; "GR Posted 2027"; spreadsheetId (string): spreadsheet URL/ID; createSheet (boolean): true to create sheet
Output / Returns: None (config updated); sheet created if createSheet=true
Side Effects: Writes row to GR Automation Config; optionally creates new output sheet; clears config cache
Errors & Fixes: Error writing config → Permissions issue on Config sheet; Verify you can edit that sheet
Notes: Used to expand system for new years; can be called programmatically or exposed as menu item

Purpose (1 line): Detect if a row is a summary/footer/total row (should be skipped)
Input Parameters: rawRow (Array): raw cell values; dispRow (Array): display values
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if summary; false if data row
Side Effects: Returns true for rows matching summary patterns (TOTAL; SUBTOTAL; SUMMARY; GRAND TOTAL; OVERALL; AVERAGE; etc.)
Errors & Fixes: False positive (data row marked as summary) → Add specific keyword to SUMMARY_KEYWORDS constant in script; re-run
Notes: Filters out junk rows automatically; improves data quality

Purpose (1 line): Detect if a row is likely a merged-cell artifact (unusual formatting; should be skipped)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if merged artifact; false if normal row
Side Effects: Heuristic check for merged cell patterns; returns true for rows with suspicious formatting
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Improve heuristic (rare); report issue; False negative (merged artifact not detected) → Unlikely; rare edge case
Notes: Helps skip formatting artifacts; improves data extraction quality

Purpose (1 line): Detect if a row is empty (all cells blank); should be skipped
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if empty; false if has data
Side Effects: Simple check: all cells are blank or whitespace
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Row has data but looks blank (rare); check for hidden characters
Notes: Filters out blank rows; improves data quality

Purpose (1 line): Check if a specific row in a sheet is hidden/filtered (visible or not)
Input Parameters: sheet (Sheet): sheet object; rowNumber (number): 1-based row number
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if row is visible; false if hidden/filtered
Side Effects: Uses Sheet.isRowHidden() to check; skips hidden rows if CONFIG.onlyIncludeVisibleRows=true
Errors & Fixes: Row visibility check incorrect → Rare; Google Sheets API edge case; ignore if rare
Notes: Respects user's manual hiding/filtering; improves data quality by excluding filtered rows

Purpose (1 line): Detect if a row is a repeated header row (same as header; should be skipped)
Input Parameters: row (Array): raw cell values from row
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if row looks like header (all header names present); false if data row
Side Effects: Checks if row contains >3 header names; skips repeated headers
Errors & Fixes: False positive (data row marked as header) → Improve threshold; rare
Notes: Filters out repeated headers (common in multi-page exports)

Purpose (1 line): Quick check: does row look like it might have data (passes basic sniff test)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if row might be data; false if obviously not (e.g.; all formatting; no values)
Side Effects: Simple heuristic: checks for non-empty cells in key columns
Errors & Fixes: False positive (trash row classified as data) → Re-check with other filters (summary; empty; merged artifact); is caught downstream
Notes: Quick filter; faster than detailed analysis; combined with other filters for accuracy

Purpose (1 line): Check if row is non-trivial (has at least some real data; not all whitespace/formatting)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if non-trivial; false if all whitespace/empty
Side Effects: Counts non-empty cells; threshold: >1 cell with data
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Row has numeric formatting but no values; caught by other filters
Notes: Helps filter out rows with only formatting/borders

Purpose (1 line): Check if a cell has meaningful content (not blank; not just whitespace)
Input Parameters: rawValue (any): raw cell value; displayValue (string): display representation
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if cell has content; false if blank/whitespace only
Side Effects: Checks both raw and display values; handles various blank representations
Errors & Fixes: Always returns false (cell seems blank) → Check cell formatting; may be custom format hiding value
Notes: Conservative check; prefers to consider cells present unless clearly blank

Purpose (1 line): Apply appropriate formatting (date; currency; percentage) to a cell based on column header
Invoked By / Menu: appendRowsWithSourceLink_() for each cell being appended
Input Parameters: header (string): column name; rawValue (any): raw value; displayValue (string): display representation
Output / Returns: Formatted value ready for Google Sheet; may include %-conversion (e.g.; 0.5 → 50%)
Side Effects: Applies formatting based on header; special handling for Payment Milestone (0-1 range → percentage)
Errors & Fixes: Wrong formatting applied → Check if column name matches expected list in COLUMN_MAPPING; Manually fix formatting if needed
Notes: Date columns: converted to Sheet date format; Currency columns: currency format; %: percentage format; Payment Milestone: 0-1 → 0-100%

Purpose (1 line): Fill Amount To Billed column if blank; use Sub Total as fallback
Input Parameters: outRow (Array): output row being built; COL (Object): column index map
Output / Returns: Modified outRow with Amount To Billed filled (or left as-is if already present)
Side Effects: Updates Amount To Billed if blank; uses Sub Total value as fallback; helps prevent missing amounts
Errors & Fixes: Fallback not applied → Sub Total column also blank; acceptable (no data available)
Notes: Improves data completeness; ensures Amount To Billed column is populated when possible

Purpose (1 line): Infer currency (PHP; EUR; USD; etc.) from cell number format or other hints
Input Parameters: outRow (Array); rowFormats (Object): format data; columnMap (Object): column indices
Output / Returns: Modified outRow with Currency column filled (or left as-is if already present); infers PHP; EUR; USD
Side Effects: Uses CONFIG.useNumberFormatCurrencyHints to optionally infer from cell format; attempts to detect currency
Errors & Fixes: Currency inferred incorrectly → Set CONFIG.useNumberFormatCurrencyHints=false; manually set currency values
Notes: Advanced feature; usually left disabled (CONFIG.useNumberFormatCurrencyHints = false)

Purpose (1 line): Search Google Drive for a folder by exact name
Input Parameters: name (string): folder name to search for
Output / Returns: Folder object (Google Drive API) or null if not found
Side Effects: Searches Drive root and subfolders; returns first matching folder; null if not found
Errors & Fixes: Folder not found → Verify folder exists on Drive; Check spelling of folder name; Must match CONFIG.sourceFolderName exactly
Notes: Folder name must match exactly (case-insensitive); if multiple folders have same name; returns first found

Purpose (1 line): Find or create the temp folder (_GR_AUTOMATION_TEMP) for converted sheets
Output / Returns: Folder object (Google Drive API) for temp folder
Side Effects: Calls findFolder_ for temp folder; creates if missing (with exact name CONFIG.tempFolderName)
Errors & Fixes: Folder creation fails → Permission denied on Drive; Verify you can create folders
Notes: Auto-creates if missing; safe to call anytime; used for storing temporary converted Google Sheets

Purpose (1 line): Check if a file name matches temp artifact naming pattern (_TEMP_ prefix)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if name looks like temp artifact (starts with _TEMP_); false otherwise
Side Effects: Simple string prefix check
Errors & Fixes: False positive (real file starts with _TEMP_) → Rename real file to avoid confusion
Notes: Used to identify temp files for cleanup; be careful not to name real files _TEMP_...

Purpose (1 line): Normalize text for lookup/matching (lowercase; trim; remove extra spaces)
Invoked By / Menu: Header matching; enrichment lookups; duplicate detection
Output / Returns: String: normalized (lowercase; trimmed; spaces collapsed)
Side Effects: Converts to lowercase; trims; collapses multiple spaces to single space
Errors & Fixes: Always returns empty → Input was empty/null; check upstream source
Notes: Used throughout for consistent text comparison; improves matching accuracy

Purpose (1 line): Normalize filename for duplicate detection (lowercase; remove special chars; collapse spaces)
Output / Returns: String: normalized filename (lowercase; special chars removed; spaces collapsed)
Side Effects: More aggressive than normalizeLookupKey_; removes punctuation; used for file matching
Errors & Fixes: Over-aggressive (valid distinctions lost) → Rare; improves matching by removing punctuation artifacts
Notes: Helps catch duplicate files with slightly different names

Purpose (1 line): Normalize PLA lookup data (text from lookup sheet cells)
Input Parameters: v (string): lookup cell value to normalize
Output / Returns: String: normalized
Side Effects: Applied to PLA ID and lookup values for case-insensitive matching
Errors & Fixes: Over-aggressive → Check if important distinctions are lost; rare issue
Notes: Ensures PLA lookup is case-insensitive; improves matching

Purpose (1 line): Normalize Drive URLs for duplicate detection (remove query params; standardize format)
Output / Returns: String: normalized URL (consistent scheme; no query params)
Side Effects: Strips query parameters; standardizes URL format; used for matching files by URL
Errors & Fixes: URL not recognized → Check if it's a valid Drive file URL; may have unusual format
Notes: Handles URL variations (www vs. non-www; query params; etc.); improves duplicate detection

Purpose (1 line): Extract Google Drive file ID from a Drive URL
Output / Returns: String: file ID (e.g.; "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ"); or null if not found
Side Effects: Uses regex to extract ID from URL patterns; returns null if no ID found
Errors & Fixes: ID not extracted → URL may be invalid or in unexpected format; check URL
Notes: Standardizes file identification across different URL formats

Purpose (1 line): Extract URL from a Google Sheet HYPERLINK formula
Output / Returns: String: URL extracted from formula; or original formula if not a HYPERLINK
Side Effects: Parses HYPERLINK(url; label) format; extracts URL; returns original if not a HYPERLINK
Errors & Fixes: URL not extracted → Formula may be non-standard; check format manually
Notes: Useful for backfill/repair; handles both formula and plain-text links

Purpose (1 line): Build a map of filename → file object for quick lookups
Output / Returns: Object: {filename → File object}; example: {"GR_REQUEST_2025.xlsx": {id; url; ...}}
Side Effects: Iterates folder; builds map keyed by filename; used for matching output rows back to source files
Errors & Fixes: Map incomplete → Folder may have many files; only first N files indexed; improve by caching more
Notes: Used for backfill matching; faster than searching Drive for each row

Purpose (1 line): Ensure ""GR Automation Perf"" sheet exists; create if missing
Output / Returns: None (sheet created if needed)
Side Effects: Creates "GR Automation Perf" sheet if missing; adds header row with column names
Errors & Fixes: Sheet creation fails → Permission denied; verify you can edit spreadsheet
Notes: Performance sheet: logs conversion; open; parse; append times for each file; useful for diagnostics

Purpose (1 line): Normalize arbitrary text (lowercase; trim)
Invoked By / Menu: Header detection; column name matching; other comparisons
Output / Returns: String: normalized (lowercase; trimmed)
Side Effects: Simpler than normalizeLookupKey_; just lowercase and trim
Errors & Fixes: Empty result → Input was empty; check upstream
Notes: Basic normalization; used throughout for text comparison

Purpose (1 line): Detect if a row is a Managed Services row (special territory/OPEX handling)
Input Parameters: materialDesc (string): Material Description; serviceShortText (string): PO Service Short Text
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if row appears to be Managed Services; false otherwise
Side Effects: Checks for keywords (SERVICE; MAINTENANCE; SUPPORT; etc.) in columns; heuristic-based
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Keyword detected in non-service row; check enrichment output
Notes: Managed Services rows often have no territory (OPEX); this flag adjusts enrichment

Purpose (1 line): Detect if WBS Element indicates OPEX (Operational Expenditure)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if WBS looks like OPEX; false otherwise
Side Effects: Checks if WBS starts with ""OPEX"" or matches OPEX pattern; heuristic
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Non-OPEX WBS detected as OPEX; check enrichment output; review WBS naming convention
Notes: OPEX entries have special handling; may not have territory

Purpose (1 line): Detect if currency code/text indicates PHP
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if PHP detected; false otherwise
Side Effects: Checks multiple PHP representations (PHP; php; ₱ symbol; etc.)
Errors & Fixes: False positive → Currency name contains ""php"" but not PHP (rare); check output
Notes: Used for currency conversion; improves flexibility in currency input

Purpose (1 line): Detect if currency code/text indicates USD
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if USD detected; false otherwise
Side Effects: Checks multiple USD representations
Errors & Fixes: False positive (rare) → Currency name contains ""usd"" but not USD; check output
Notes: If USD: no conversion applied (amount stays as-is)

Purpose (1 line): Detect if currency code/text indicates EUR
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if EUR detected; false otherwise
Side Effects: Checks multiple EUR representations
Errors & Fixes: False positive (rare) → Currency name contains ""eur"" but not EUR; check output
Notes: If EUR: converted to USD using CONFIG.usdConversionRate

Purpose (1 line): Parse an amount value (handle text; currency symbols; commas; etc.)
Invoked By / Menu: Cell formatting; enrichment logic; amount fallback
Input Parameters: v (any): value to parse (number; string; currency text)
Output / Returns: Number: parsed amount; or NaN if unparseable
Side Effects: Removes currency symbols (PHP; €; $; etc.); removes commas; converts to number
Errors & Fixes: NaN result → Value is non-numeric (e.g.; ""N/A""; ""TBD""); acceptable; amount left blank
Notes: Flexible parsing; handles various amount formats

Purpose (1 line): Check if file should be skipped due to size (> 10 MB)
Output / Returns: Boolean: true if file > 10 MB (skip); false if <= 10 MB (process)
Side Effects: Checks file size; returns true if > 10MB threshold
Errors & Fixes: Size check fails → File size unavailable from Drive API (rare); assume safe to process
Notes: 10 MB threshold prevents Drive API conversion timeouts; users can split large files or adjust threshold in CONFIG

Purpose (1 line): Extract full month name from a Date object
Output / Returns: String: full month name (e.g.; "January"; "February"; "March")
Side Effects: Converts month number to English month name; returns empty if date invalid
Errors & Fixes: Empty result → Date object invalid; check upstream source
Notes: Used for tracker Month column; improves reporting/filtering

Purpose (1 line): Write a year→sheet→spreadsheet mapping to GR Automation Config sheet
Input Parameters: year (number): year to add; sheetName (string): target sheet name; spreadsheetId (string): target spreadsheet ID/URL
Output / Returns: None (row appended to config)
Side Effects: Appends row to "GR Automation Config" sheet; clears config cache
Errors & Fixes: Write fails → Permission denied on Config sheet; verify you can edit
Notes: Used for multi-year multi-spreadsheet setup

Purpose (1 line): Get the output sheet name for a given year (default or configured)
Output / Returns: String: sheet name (e.g.; "GR Posted 2025"); or null if not found/configured
Side Effects: Looks up in readConfigMappings_() first; fallback to CONFIG.outputSheets
Errors & Fixes: Null result → Year not in config and not in CONFIG.outputSheets; add configuration
Notes: Supports both default (CONFIG.outputSheets) and custom mappings (GR Automation Config)

Purpose (1 line): Count how many expected column headers are present in a given header row
Input Parameters: columnMap (Object): column mapping {header name → index}; headers (Array): raw header values from row
Output / Returns: Number: count of matched expected columns
Side Effects: Iterates expected columns; checks if present in header row; counts matches
Errors & Fixes: Low count → Few expected columns match; likely wrong sheet
Notes: Used for sheet scoring; sheets with more header matches are preferred

Purpose (1 line): Get the bound spreadsheet object (main controller spreadsheet)
Output / Returns: SpreadsheetApp object for bound spreadsheet
Side Effects: Returns the spreadsheet the script is bound to
Errors & Fixes: Fails if script not bound to spreadsheet (rare); verify in Apps Script project settings
Notes: Fundamental function; used to access main control spreadsheet

Purpose (1 line): Get list of configured years for year picker menu
Output / Returns: Array: [2025; 2026; ...]; based on CONFIG.outputSheets keys
Side Effects: Returns configured years; shown in year picker modal
Errors & Fixes: Empty array → CONFIG.outputSheets is empty; add years to CONFIG
Notes: Used by UI to populate year dropdown menu

Purpose (1 line): Clear the in-memory config mapping cache
Output / Returns: None (cache cleared)
Side Effects: Resets _CACHE.configMappings to null; forces reload on next call
Errors & Fixes: Cache invalidation edge case (rare) → Config changes not reflected; manually call clearConfigMappingsCache_(); reload
Notes: Cache improves performance; clear when config changes

Purpose (1 line): Get cached PLA Lookup map (with optional force refresh)
Input Parameters: ss (Spreadsheet): spreadsheet containing PLA Lookup; force (boolean): true to bypass cache
Output / Returns: Object: {PLA ID → lookup data}; or {} if not found
Side Effects: Returns cached map or loads fresh if cache miss or force=true; caches per spreadsheet ID
Errors & Fixes: Cache stale (lookup data changed) → Either wait for new run (cache clears per file) or call with force=true
Notes: Caching improves performance; cache is scoped per spreadsheet ID

Purpose (1 line): Clear cached PLA Lookup maps (all or for one spreadsheet)
Invoked By / Menu: After lookup sheet updates; refreshing data
Input Parameters: ss (Spreadsheet): optional; if provided; clears only that SS's cache; if null; clears all
Output / Returns: None (cache cleared)
Side Effects: Resets _CACHE.plaLookupMapBySsId; full or partial clear depending on parameter
Errors & Fixes: Cache never refreshed → May indicate cache not being cleared after updates; manually call after modifying PLA Lookup
Notes: Use when PLA Lookup data changes mid-run

Purpose (1 line): Extract rows using anchor column detection (find start/end of data block by looking for anchor columns)
Input Parameters: startRow; endRow (number): row range; columnMap; anchorColumnIndices (Array); rawValues; sheet
Output / Returns: Array: extracted rows between anchors
Side Effects: Advanced row extraction using anchor columns (e.g.; rows starting with PO No. and ending with a key column)
Errors & Fixes: No rows extracted → Anchors may not be appropriate; fallback to simpler extraction
Notes: More sophisticated than simple row filtering; useful for complex spreadsheet layouts

Purpose (1 line): Take candidate files grouped by year and build final processing queue respecting limits
Output / Returns: Array: [fileInfo; fileInfo; ...]; final list of files to process in this run
Side Effects: Flattens candidates; respects per-year and total limits; returns final list
Errors & Fixes: Empty list → All candidates filtered out; may have no new files or all files failed too many times
Notes: Ensures processing respects limits and prevents timeouts
